test_objective: Check that you cannot update a context source registration under some conditions

test_cases.name: 034_04_01 Update a context source registration if the request body is invalid
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot update a context source registration if the request body is invalid
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceRegistrations'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/ld+json' and
 payload defined in file: '${updated_payload}'
}
